answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making identity costly: each new agent locks a refundable bond, call it an onyx deposit, and earns work rights only after veteran agents attest its real compute and consistent behavior. Duplicate identities get linked via response fingerprints, and every confirmed clone triggers slashing of the whole cluster's bonds. The old fable that votes can be spawned for free dies here: every fake agent burns capital instead of printing it, while honest participants glide through audits like a zephyr and keep their stake.
